newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials see modest gains, Nasdaq holds firm.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials see modest gains, Nasdaq holds firm.

text.p: U.S. stocks bounced higher on Monday, continuing Friday's rally, before cooling slightly as investors took profits.

The New York Stock Exchange set trading curbs after the Dow Jones industrial average gained about 70 points. In late morning trading, the Dow was up about 55 points or 0.75 percent at 7491. Nasdaq rose about seven points to 1412.
The long bond was off 11/32 at a 6.81 percent yield. The Standard & Poor's futures index was up 1.50 to 864.
"People here have made a lot of money very quickly and I would say intraday we would probably see some profit taking," said Richard Cripps, chief market strategist at Legg Mason Wood Walker.
Besides the profit taking from Friday's record-setting run, Cripps said he would expect the market to cool if the bond market gave back some of its gains from last week.
